This plot is very small, only a small piece near the house, and beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does. I went to school a little, so I know beans can fix their own nitrogen, and anyway I have no cash to spare for fertilizer on this plot — if I get any FISP coupon this year it goes on the maize plot, not here. I will put some manure from the goats because I have it at home, and I will use seed I kept from last harvest since the improved bean seed at the agro-dealer is too costly for such a small piece. My wife and I will weed it ourselves, no need to hire anyone for 0.08 ha.
